subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Over-Reliance on Spreadsheets
description: Learn Over-Reliance on Spreadsheets in one minute.

hook.text: A billion-dollar supply chain runs on one Excel file. The formula in cell G42 has been wrong for two years.

buildup.text: Many companies still manage demand planning in spreadsheets—manually, slowly, and error-prone.

discovery.text: Spreadsheets lack version control, audit trails, and collaboration features. Errors propagate undetected.

twist.text: 88% of spreadsheets contain errors, according to research. The bigger the file, the worse the risk.

climax.text: Dedicated planning tools automate calculations, enforce consistency, and scale to thousands of SKUs.

punchline.text: Spreadsheets start forecasts. Systems sustain them.

quiz.question: What percentage of spreadsheets are estimated to contain errors?
